name: lantern-night
vibe: A night lantern-festival world — deep ink sky over a shimmering water line, glowing terracotta paper lanterns endlessly rising past a haloed cream moon, twinkling stars and wandering sage fireflies. Round Caprasimo display in warm paper-cream; headlines swing in like hung lanterns and the key word GLOWS. Magical, warm-in-the-dark, festival-calm — events, launches after dark, hospitality, celebrations and any story that comes alive when the sun goes down.
